images.prompt: Create one premium travel website hero, landscape 16:9, photorealistic editorial travel illustration evoking Santo Domingo Tehuantepec in Oaxaca's Isthmus, Mexico. A warm sunlit low-rise traditional town street, weathered pastel ochre and terracotta stucco facades, tiled roofs and open shaded market stall in foreground showing rich Tehuana floral embroidery on dark fabric and colorful woven textiles. A few anonymous local pedestrians at natural scale, tropical green shade trees, realistic Mexican daylight, beautiful lived-in atmosphere, no staged folkloric show. Focus on authentic materials and textiles rather than an exact identifiable monument; do not invent a famous cathedral or archaeological pyramid. Wide balanced composition with uncluttered left quarter for title, natural photographic color, 35mm travel photography aesthetic, crisp organic detail, no text, no readable signs, no logos, no collage.
